title: Oil Rises From Six-Week Low Amid Uncertainty Over US-Iran Deal
title_zh: 由于美伊协议的不确定性，油价从六周低点上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Oil rose from a six-week low amid uncertainty over the outlook for a peace deal to end the war in Iran.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——由于结束伊朗战争的和平协议前景存在不确定性，油价从六周低点上涨。
